catalog.name: NYC Mobility Metadata Catalog
catalog.description: Metadata catalog for cross-source analysis of NYC taxi mobility, taxi zones, and hourly weather.

datasets.name: yellow_taxi
datasets.description: Curated Yellow Taxi trips for January 2024. Original TLC column names are preserved.
datasets.notes: Invalid target-period records, non-positive trip durations, invalid zone references, and extreme trip distances above 1000 miles were excluded. Zero-distance trips and negative monetary values were preserved.

datasets.name: green_taxi
datasets.description: Curated Green Taxi trips for January 2024. Original TLC column names are preserved.
datasets.notes: Invalid target-period records, non-positive trip durations, invalid zone references, and extreme trip distances above 1000 miles were excluded. Zero-distance trips and negative monetary values were preserved.

datasets.name: taxi_zones
datasets.granularity: one row per TLC taxi zone
datasets.description: Reference dataset mapping TLC LocationID values to borough, taxi-zone name, and service-zone classification.

datasets.name: weather_hourly
datasets.source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
datasets.description: Hourly weather representation for NYC Central Park during January 2024, derived from NOAA Local Climatological Data.
datasets.notes: FM-15 routine observations are preferred. Trace precipitation is represented as precipitation_trace=true and has_precipitation=true without inventing a numeric precipitation amount. Missing weather observations remain unknown.

semantic_concepts.name: pickup_datetime
semantic_concepts.description: Date and time when a taxi trip begins.

semantic_concepts.name: dropoff_datetime
semantic_concepts.description: Date and time when a taxi trip ends.

semantic_concepts.name: pickup_zone_id
semantic_concepts.description: TLC taxi-zone identifier for the trip pickup location.

semantic_concepts.name: dropoff_zone_id
semantic_concepts.description: TLC taxi-zone identifier for the trip drop-off location.

semantic_concepts.name: taxi_zone_id
semantic_concepts.description: Primary TLC identifier of a taxi zone.

semantic_concepts.name: zone_name
semantic_concepts.description: Human-readable TLC taxi-zone name.

semantic_concepts.name: borough
semantic_concepts.description: NYC borough associated with a TLC taxi zone.

semantic_concepts.name: trip_distance
semantic_concepts.description: Recorded distance of a taxi trip in miles.

semantic_concepts.name: passenger_count
semantic_concepts.description: Recorded number of passengers for a taxi trip.

semantic_concepts.name: fare_amount
semantic_concepts.description: Base fare amount associated with a taxi trip.

semantic_concepts.name: tip_amount
semantic_concepts.description: Tip amount associated with a taxi trip.

semantic_concepts.name: total_amount
semantic_concepts.description: Total recorded monetary amount associated with a taxi trip.

semantic_concepts.name: weather_hour
semantic_concepts.description: Clock-hour bucket represented by an hourly weather record.

semantic_concepts.name: temperature
semantic_concepts.description: Observed dry-bulb air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit.

semantic_concepts.name: relative_humidity
semantic_concepts.description: Observed relative humidity percentage.

semantic_concepts.name: precipitation_amount
semantic_concepts.description: Numeric hourly precipitation amount in inches when measurable.

semantic_concepts.name: precipitation_trace
semantic_concepts.description: Indicates trace precipitation that is present but lacks a measurable numeric amount.

semantic_concepts.name: precipitation_status
semantic_concepts.description: Three-valued precipitation status: true means precipitation occurred, false means dry, null means unknown.

semantic_concepts.name: wind_speed
semantic_concepts.description: Observed wind speed in miles per hour.

semantic_concepts.name: visibility
semantic_concepts.description: Observed visibility in miles.

relationships.name: yellow_pickup_zone
relationships.description: Maps each Yellow Taxi pickup LocationID to its TLC taxi-zone record.

relationships.name: yellow_dropoff_zone
relationships.description: Maps each Yellow Taxi drop-off LocationID to its TLC taxi-zone record.

relationships.name: green_pickup_zone
relationships.description: Maps each Green Taxi pickup LocationID to its TLC taxi-zone record.

relationships.name: green_dropoff_zone
relationships.description: Maps each Green Taxi drop-off LocationID to its TLC taxi-zone record.

relationships.name: yellow_pickup_weather_hour
relationships.description: Aligns a Yellow Taxi pickup timestamp with the corresponding hourly NYC weather bucket.

relationships.name: green_pickup_weather_hour
relationships.description: Aligns a Green Taxi pickup timestamp with the corresponding hourly NYC weather bucket.

semantic_rules.name: rainy_hour
semantic_rules.description: An hour is rainy when NOAA indicates measurable or trace precipitation.
semantic_rules.result_semantics: Includes trace precipitation. Missing weather is not classified as rainy.

semantic_rules.name: dry_hour
semantic_rules.description: An hour is dry only when precipitation status is explicitly false.
semantic_rules.result_semantics: Missing precipitation status is not interpreted as dry.

semantic_rules.name: yellow_pickup_hour
semantic_rules.description: Hourly time bucket for a Yellow Taxi pickup.
semantic_rules.result_semantics: Used to align Yellow Taxi trips with hourly weather.

semantic_rules.name: green_pickup_hour
semantic_rules.description: Hourly time bucket for a Green Taxi pickup.
semantic_rules.result_semantics: Used to align Green Taxi trips with hourly weather.
